messages.author: e76bf5e76da333a2
messages.subject: Group specific smoothing in R-inla
parts:
Dear R-inla group 

Below is a parametric mean structure specification for my model 
 
          responce ~TIME+group+ I(group* TIME)



I want to modify this model by where the effect of time is modelled as a smooth function f(·) and  f is modelled with a second-order random walk (RW2) prior with unknown precision λ_f. 
In doing this I want to keep features of the above parametric model. That is, I want to assume a group specific smoothing. Is there a way to do that in R-inla. 

Below is the full code which I want to be modified 

1. Parametric 
NegBinmixed<-inla(GAMB ~TIME+VILLAGE +SEASON+ I(VILLAGE* TIME) + f(id2, model = "iid")
                            , family="nbinomial", data = IRC,control.family = list(prior="gaussian", param = c(0,0.01)),
                             control.predictor = list(compute=TRUE),
                            control.compute=list(dic=TRUE, cpo=TRUE, waic=TRUE)) 

2. Smooth 
SemiNegBinmixed= inla(GAMB ~VILLAGE +SEASON+ f(id2, model = "iid") +f(TIME,model="rw2",prior="loggamma",param=c(1,0.01)),
                             data=IRC, family="poisson", control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE),
                              control.compute=list(dic=TRUE, cpo=TRUE, waic=TRUE))



Kind regards 
Belay

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Group specific smoothing in R-inla
parts:
Hi,

sorry, I do not understand what you really want. do you want

responce ~ f(TIME, model="rw2") + group + I(group*TIME) 

?

or you want want to keep the linear structure and add a correction in
TIME, like

ec = list(A = cbind(1, TIME), e = c(0,0))

responce ~ TIME + f(TIME, model="rw2", extraconstr = ec, rankdef=2) +
group + I(group*TIME)

?

I didn't understand ``I want to keep features of the above
parametric model.''

H

Sorry, it should be

f(TIME, model="rw2", replicate = group)

that will create replications overer group with the same smoothing.
